name: Honey-Butter Toast

ingredients.name: honey, divided, plus more for drizzling

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 165°C (325°F). Line a small rimmed baking sheet with parchment. In a small bowl, stir together butter, brown sugar, 1 1/2 teaspoons of the honey, salt, cinnamon, and cardamom (if using) until smooth.
If desired, trim crusts from bread to yield a perfectly square slice. Spread a thin layer of butter mixture over top, bottom, and sides of each bread slice. Place on prepared baking sheet.
Bake until very lightly golden-brown, 12 to 16 minutes. Flip slices and continue to bake until evenly golden, 5 to 7 minutes longer.
Remove from oven and cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and cool until crispy, about 10 minutes.
While toast cools, whisk together yogurt and vanilla bean paste until smooth. Stir in remaining 1 teaspoon honey, maintaining a swirl by not completely stirring it in.
Place crisped toast on a plate; dollop with yogurt, then spoon berries on top. Drizzle with more honey, if desired. Serve immediately.

description: This riff on brick toast is fluffy and soft on the inside with a shatteringly crisp honey-butter exterior. The recipe comes together quickly and then bakes in the oven, so this luxurious breakfast or snack is almost entirely hands off.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom (optional); Fresh mixed berries, for serving

Optional substitutions: thick slice brioche → challah white bread or milk bread or soft white bread
author: Megan O. Steintrager
